MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary="//"

--//
Content-Type: text/x-shellscript; charset="us-ascii"

#!/bin/bash
# Set GDAKI driver module params BEFORE the nvidia module is loaded by the
# GPU operator / kubelet. Persists across reboots and all node replacements.
set -euxo pipefail
cat > /etc/modprobe.d/nvidia-gdaki.conf <<'EOF'
options nvidia NVreg_EnableStreamMemOPs=1 NVreg_RegistryDwords="PeerMappingOverride=1;"
EOF
# Rebuild initramfs if the nvidia module is baked there (custom AMI); ignore if absent.
dracut --force 2>/dev/null || update-initramfs -u 2>/dev/null || true
# If nvidia is already loaded this early (unlikely pre-kubelet), reload it so the
# params take effect without a reboot on first boot.
if lsmod | grep -q '^nvidia '; then
  rmmod nvidia_uvm nvidia_drm nvidia_peermem gdrdrv nvidia_modeset 2>/dev/null || true
  rmmod nvidia 2>/dev/null || true
  modprobe nvidia 2>/dev/null || true
fi
